summary_candidates.reason: Bright and dark excursions preserve directionality, are source-frame auditable, and p90-p10 ordering is more stable from core to wide than MAD in the four-stone comparison.

It is largely redundant with excursion (about 0.91 average cross-stone rank agreement in complete coarse configurations) while core-to-wide rank consistency is lower (about 0.80 versus about 0.90 for total excursion).

global_constraints: Whole-stone and band-relative activation remain separate observables.
No numeric winner score or quality grade is defined.
No hard support cutoff is introduced from this four-stone sample.
Dynamic-support outputs remain committed for QC/falsification.
Semantic bands remain recorded-image correspondence approximations, not exact physical facet identities.
